repository_scope: 2026 dimension/context confirmation, recorded environment/raw results, review reanalysis, and historical rerun source snapshots
excluded: unverified fitted ridge references and external review scripts
verification_limits: A source hash establishes byte identity, not scientific correctness.
The original runtime checks verified checkpoint/schedule content on the cluster; those binaries are not shipped.
Fresh GPU training has not been repeated as part of GitHub packaging.
Historical source snapshots have packaging hashes, not the confirmation prospective freeze.
